I see you have 3 nodes on your canvas: game (logic), index (input), and an unconnected node. Let's clean this up so it's exactly what the app needs.

1. Keep the game node (logic) — this is where the Tic Tac Toe game rules, turn order, input validation, move validation, and UI rendering happen.
2. Keep the index node (input) — this is the single self-contained GUI page that renders the complete app interface and wires the game logic.
3. Delete the unconnected node — that's not part of the Tic Tac Toe app, so it doesn't belong here.

Now you have exactly 2 nodes, and the app is ready. The game node does all the logic and UI rendering, and the index node wires it together. No extra nodes are needed.
